info.name: TheLyfex Admin Backend (Day 1) — Collection
info.description:
Admin backend API tests for admin-backend. Includes happy paths and edge cases (401/403/400/404) with auth chaining.

Variables used:

- baseUrl (default [http://localhost:4100](http://localhost:4100))
    
- adminEmail, adminPassword
    
- adminAccessToken, adminRefreshToken
    
- adminId, roleId
    
- userId
    
- roomId
    
- reportId
    
- sessionId
    
- paymentId
    

Notes:

- Run "Admin Auth → Login" first to set tokens.
    
- Some endpoints require permissions (roles/permissions). If your current admin role lacks permissions you will receive 403 (expected in edge-case tests).
